items.title: Joe Darensbourg and Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1957-04-18
items.q: I was talking to Louis about Buddy not too long ago, and he's telling me when Buddy died, he said he buried him.

ctx.x: Would you say as long as that sounds better than you heard?

Yes, sir. Louis says that, too. Uh-huh. Louis and Buddy was good friends. I was talking to Louis about Buddy not too long ago, and he's telling me when Buddy died, he said he buried him. Oh, yeah? He's the one who put up the money for his funeral.
He buried, uh, Joe Oliver, too. Did Louis tell you about Joe before he died? Louis said, Joe, Joe was working. Well, he wasn't working. He had a little fruit stand in Atlanta, Georgia.
